changes.source_value: Sends the content to the server for further processing
changes.target_value: Sends the content to the server for further processing

change_types_explanation.ADDED: Property exists in target but not in source
change_types_explanation.DELETED: Property exists in source but not in target
change_types_explanation.MODIFIED: Same key, different value, same line position
change_types_explanation.MOVED: Same key and value, different line numbers
change_types_explanation.MOVED_AND_MODIFIED: Same key, different value, different line numbers

output_format.description: The diff output is a JSON object containing:
output_format.source_file: Path to the source property file
output_format.target_file: Path to the target property file
output_format.changes: Array of change objects, each containing:

change_object.type: One of: ADDED, DELETED, MODIFIED, MOVED, MOVED_AND_MODIFIED
change_object.source_line: Line number in source file (null for ADDED)
change_object.target_line: Line number in target file (null for DELETED)
change_object.source_value: Value in source file (null for ADDED)
change_object.target_value: Value in target file (null for DELETED)

summary.moved_and_modified: Count of moved and modified properties
